**A [[Richter scale|M{{sub|w}}]] 6.2 [[earthquake]] with an [[epicenter]] in the [[Sea of Marmara]] strikes [[Istanbul]], [[Turkey]], injuring at least 359 people. [https://apnews.com/article/turkey-earthquake-istanbul-sea-marmara-magnitude-emergency-46f20a2c0b6fa3cad7634d28d1f7e5d7 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2023–2025 global coral bleaching event]]
**The [[International Coral Reef Initiative]] announces that over 84% of the world's [[coral reef]]s are affected by a [[coral bleaching#Mass bleaching events|coral bleaching]] event since 2023, considered the most intense on record. [https://apnews.com/article/coral-reef-bleaching-climate-change-fdbeddf7ae3ccc9d7cf85d1c3267e581 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Death and funeral of Pope Francis]]
**The body of [[Pope Francis]] is moved from [[Domus Sanctae Marthae]] to [[St. Peter's Basilica]], and [[Lying in state|lies in state]] for a 3-day public viewing. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/pope-francis-body-st-peters-basilica-lie-in-state/ (CBS News)]
*[[2025 India–Pakistan diplomatic crisis]], [[India–Pakistan relations]]
**[[India]] announces several measures targeting [[Pakistan]] including closing the main [[India–Pakistan border|border crossing]] linking the two countries, suspending the [[Indus Water Treaty]], and expelling [[High Commission of Pakistan, New Delhi|Pakistani]] [[diplomat]]s after the [[2025 Pahalgam attack|attack]] on tourists in [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Indian-administered Kashmir]] yesterday. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ce8g2njm2d2o (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*The [[Jordan]]ian [[Ministry of the Interior (Jordan)|interior ministry]] bans all activities of the [[Sunni Islam|Sunni]] [[Muslim Brotherhood]] organization in the country, seizes the organization's assets, and closes all of its offices, including its political wing in the country, the [[Islamic Action Front]]. The [[Government of Jordan|Jordanian government]] links the group to [[sabotage]] plots and accuses it of "[[destabilizing]]" the country.
